use.read_order: Match the question to a topic; answer with its relevant step numbers and exact labels. Read only its cited spans when needed.
use.invalidate: Validate with python tools/check_handoff.py on a changed checkout. Any bound source hash mismatch makes this cache stale; review changed facts before rebinding.
use.current_state: No current statuses, prompts, counts, return identities, credentials or credit balances are cached. Use the existing selected process guide/runner when those facts are required.
use.not_authorization: Navigation data only; does not execute another engine, select scope, answer SME questions or clear gates.

topics.answer: Follow Your next step for one selected process. Copilot retrieves through approved Zowe/Db2 MCP only; Claude analyzes, builds, tests and reviews approved local files with no MCP. The Coordinator owns evidence and gates; an actual human owns scope Save and SME answers.

Keep each editable authoring package outside the workspace. Its manifest.md, process-specific.md and original export are inputs. Under processes/PROCESS_ID, the Coordinator freezes input/process-input.md, input/sources and analysis/process-context.json. Never add input/process-specific.md, per-rule Markdown or alter frozen evidence.

Upload the canonical job/step or online transaction manifest in Process manifest. Enter prose notes separately in Add optional analysis context → Process Markdown path on this workstation. Claude can derive the table from cited notes/JCL facts locally; unresolved identities remain prerequisites.

Use CPython 3.12 and the repository locked environment. Start.ps1 launches the repository root; it has no -Root. For a separate existing local writable workspace, initialize knowledge with preflight, then use workbench.launch --root WORKSPACE --port 8765. Keep the terminal open and one Coordinator per workspace. Windows11 desktop acceptance is distinct from WindowsServer CI.

Save setup writes nonsecret workstation instructions and shows Add a process. Finish the displayed secure/native client actions when retrieval is needed; configuration is not connectivity. Click Add a process, supply the manifest and source/notes choices, then Prepare process guide. Follow Your next step for the current prompt.

Mainframe source/member and dataset metadata use read-only Zowe CLI. Choose existing profiles, create secure profiles with actual host/aliases, or import the approved config/schema. Enter credentials only in secure clients. I*/Z* names are environment-scoped candidates, not substitutions. A local availability/config check does not authenticate or prove coverage.

Db2 catalog/DDL and requested rows must come through approved typed MCP via Copilot. Setup can prepare an existing endpoint or approved local gateway using nonsecret host/service/database/DDF/driver/CA/loopback-port/read-limit fields. Gateway startup and secure prompts are separate. Claude must never use an ODBC/HTTP/MCP bypass.

Use Copy Copilot prompt from the current process guide unchanged. Copilot writes files and response.json only into that request-bound inbox with original identity, hashes and provenance. Click Continue after Copilot saves files; missing/denied/partial/ambiguous results remain gates. Never request fictional names from a real mainframe.

Default Yes selects conversion scope, not review approval or success. Use Requirements filters, choose Yes/No, then Save requirements and continue. Save pins immutable requirements Markdown and invalidates old tasks. Every No retains “Not converted because selected No in requirements.” Unsaved choices survive in-app route/process switches only; changed hashes/revisions block Save until explicit Reload saved choices. Required dependencies still need evidence; scope locks at packet issue.

Copy the live Claude prompt after saved scope; Claude owns local analysis, implementation, tests and independent review. Read its exact task and analysis inbox, not a screenshot hash. After tested adapter changes restart an idle service if loaded code changed, --refresh and submit fresh hash-bound --analysis-file. Accepted analysis is not semantic verification.

New fixture contracts require at least 20 distinct runtime-randomized source-valid executed states per applicable supported logic/layout/job-step obligation, plus outcomes, boundaries, sequential/linked effects, invalid inputs and adversarial tests. Duplicated cases, unreachable/small domains and unsupported logic retain named deficits. Compare actual target outputs to frozen source expectations; this is finite scoped evidence, not native parity.

Preserve evidenced source behavior even when it appears incorrect. Consolidation/refactoring needs verified observable equivalence and every source obligation mapped to target/tests. Record preserved source issues instead of silently fixing or retiring them. A functionality-specific Db2/mainframe operation without a verified replacement remains a named gap.

Use an online transaction/program/map manifest and full programs, BMS, symbolic COPY and CSD resources. Choose source-bound field/action checkboxes. The literal character BMS profile can verify layout/rendering, but native SEND/RECEIVE, buffers, AID, flow/state/security/database effects remain exact obligations. Layout-only targets disable controller execution; generic HTTP success is not CICS parity.

Share the one issued sme-checklist.html. The actual SME answers Yes/No/Not sure, enters their name and clicks Save review file; return the downloaded PROCESS_ID-sme-return.html. Import once with matching real attribution, or use one designated HTML/XLSX inbox only. Agents never fill answers. Any nonempty commentary/correction remains unresolved even with Yes; do not erase concerns.

After an accepted report exists, choose Evidence & reports → Inspect evidence → Program comparison, select Program, then Gaps only or Selected No. Read exact source/target spans, versions, tests/witnesses and specific reasons. Candidate generation is not verified conversion. Program, source and process-wide gates remain separate; filters read frozen evidence and do not rerun tests.

Source coverage must account for every exported file and physical line with a disposition and evidence/reason, including unknown text and selected No. Retained, selected, original, verified and omitted counts differ. Repeated invocations do not inflate unique/job totals; cross-job membership remains visible. Unknown estate/type totals are never zero.

Db2 / SQLite shows registered hash-checked local artifacts and read-only paged records. Choose Application database/Table; use Exact text for significant leading-zero IDs, Exact integer or NULL as applicable. Prepare schema database requires saved Yes scope, closure and accepted Db2 MCP provenance. Schema-only storage can be empty and does not implement business SQL or migrate data.

Compare keyed before/after observations for the same input/run/environment/scope and consistency. Separate run inserts/updates/deletes from initial/final baseline differences; equal delta counts cannot hide historical rows or prove whole-table equality. The approved Db2 row tool uses uncommitted read, so native parity is withheld without qualified consistent observation. Never execute mainframe jobs to obtain tests.

Use the registered accepted report and management.pptx links in Reports. The deck has six editable slides using the same frozen counts/evidence; AST statements are not COBOL rule counts. Bundle reuses immutable evidence only after eligible reporting; stop the UI before direct runner bundle and relaunch the same workspace. No executive label clears native/gate gaps.

Import actual attributed usage receipts. GitHub Copilot credits used is the primary per-account count; other providers remain separate. Evidenced zero differs from Unknown. Never convert tokens/request counts into credits or infer billing/allowance from config. Copilot may retrieve an available receipt; Claude/local Coordinator imports it.

Record actual stage work windows, close them before human waits and separate framework work. Forecast matching counting units using explicit assumptions or complete attributed qualified pilots. Business process is not JCL PROC. Fictional/blocked/partial/unmeasured/excluded-scope pilots cannot establish a complete-estate rate. Example arithmetic is not a promised completion date.

Python/SQLite is the current executable target profile. Oracle, BigQuery, Java and .NET are future candidates, not selectable implemented conversions. Each requires TargetBackend generation/comparison plus the same source, scope, execution, linked-state/adversarial/report gates. BigQuery needs workload/transaction qualification; configuration alone does not add an adapter.

Reopen the same workspace and stable process ID to preserve the ledger, frozen source, guide/scope/task hashes and single SME quota. Changed inputs require an explicit new ID. Stop work windows before closing; keep one Coordinator and use eligible Resume after named cause is resolved. Never rewrite frozen artifacts, delete lock/command markers or issue another checklist.

This reference has no live status. Use the selected running UI guide for read-only current state, or existing runner status after stopping the UI. Existing runner agent inspection returns current task/paths through the Coordinator but can enable historical local workflow, advance queued work or prepare retrieval; it is not universally read-only. Never query raw SQLite/ledger data or create a Claude HTTP/MCP status proxy.

Read the exact named gate and current checkpoint. Refresh guide after a completed local task; stale/failed reads hide current prompts. Missing exports need bounded Copilot retrieval, unsaved scope needs actual Save, missing analysis needs a fresh hash-bound local return, and WAITING_SME needs the authentic human return. PENDING is not accepted; INDETERMINATE needs fresh inspection before any new mutation.

The shared job aid uses clearly fictional batch/CICS/native-utility packages. Its real UI captures are macOS; Windows11 instructions are not desktop acceptance. Some result images are labelled historical fixture examples, not this sample completing. Keep fictional flag checked, exclude examples from real inventory/forecasts and never infer SME answers, live connections or observed native parity.
